name: Acousto-Optic Random Access Scanning with Parallel Channels
definition: Random-access laser beam positioning using acousto-optic (AO) deflectors to address voxels in a display volume, coupled in parallel channels to increase voxel count and maintain image intensity.
summary: Acousto-Optic Random Access Scanning with Parallel Channels is a volumetric display technique using multiple acousto-optic deflectors to increase voxel count and maintain intensity, unlike single-channel scanners.
